_note: Multi-unit demo seed (task A-08) for the FICTIONAL hyperscale sample data/RFP/samples/rfp_hyperscale_campus.txt, turned into a PDF by scripts/txt_to_pdf.py. requirements.quote: Design and supply integrated power and cooling infrastructure for a new AI training campus.
requirements.text: Design and supply integrated power and cooling for a new AI training campus.

requirements.quote: IT capacity: approximately 48 MW critical load, Phase 1
requirements.text: About 48 MW critical IT load in phase 1.

requirements.quote: Redundancy: 2N at utility/substation level, N+1 at rack level
requirements.text: 2N redundancy at utility and substation level; N+1 at rack level.

requirements.quote: Power architecture: preference for 800VDC rack-level distribution where mature; open to hybrid AC/DC
requirements.text: 800 V DC rack-level distribution preferred where mature; hybrid AC/DC acceptable.

requirements.quote: Rack density: minimum 120kW per rack, liquid cooling required at rack and chip level
requirements.text: At least 120 kW per rack, with rack- and chip-level liquid cooling.

response.response: Direct-to-chip cold plates with row-level CDUs sized for 120 kW per rack.

requirements.quote: Site: single greenfield site, Central Texas, grid interconnect pending utility approval
requirements.text: Single greenfield site in Central Texas; grid interconnect still pending utility approval.

requirements.quote: Timeline: energization required within 9 months of award

response.response: Nine months is achievable for prefabricated power; liquid cooling lead time to be confirmed.

requirements.quote: Compliance: UL, IEC 61439, NEC Article 645 applicable
requirements.text: Comply with UL, IEC 61439 and NEC Article 645.

requirements.quote: Deployment preference: prefabricated / modular systems preferred to compress on-site schedule
requirements.text: Prefabricated or modular systems preferred, to shorten site work.

response.response: Factory-built power pods adapted to site, delivered tested.

requirements.quote: Scope requested: grid interface through rack-level power and cooling; compute integration to be coordinated separately
requirements.text: Scope: grid interface to rack-level power and cooling; compute integration handled separately.
